camera.plainEnglish: The camera sits behind the shoulder. Pressing aim pulls it in and records that you are looking down the sights. That press is not the use key.
camera.whyGame: A trace from the feet hits the ground you are standing on. The shot has to start at the camera, where the crosshair is.

expansions.title: The shoulder button
expansions.detail: The shoulder button's Triggered pin starts the aim trace.

expansions.title: Cover
expansions.detail: Aim does not ask the cover to do anything. Use does.

expansions.title: The boom
expansions.detail: Pulling the camera in is a camera change. It is not a speed change.

quiz.prompt: The player presses the shoulder button to look down the sights. What should that press record?
choices: That the squadmate should turn around
quiz.why: Aim records a look. It does not use an actor.

quiz.prompt: The aim excerpt assigns Aiming = true inside the aim action. What did the player just press?
choices: The shoulder button bound to the aim action
quiz.why: That function is the aim action.

quiz.prompt: The shoulder button fires Triggered. What runs immediately after that pin?
choices: A line trace that starts at the camera
Calling Interact on the hit actor
quiz.why: The pin starts the aim trace.

quiz.prompt: You set Aiming from Tick so the sights never feel late. What keeps happening after the player releases aim?
choices: The pawn stays marked as aiming
quiz.why: The action is the press and the release. Tick is neither.

quiz.prompt: The crosshair is on a window and the trace starts at the feet. What does the player shoot?
choices: The ground, or the cover the feet are behind
No shot at all, if a third-person camera were unable to trace
quiz.why: Start where the camera is looking.

quiz.prompt: Aiming and interacting are two different graphs.
quiz.why: Aim records a look. Interact asks an actor.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the aim write, not a use?
choices: Aiming = true inside the aim action
A call to Interact on the hit actor
A clamp of reserve into the magazine
A squadmate step along the route for the squadmate
quiz.why: The bool is the sights.

quiz.prompt: A designer lengthens the spring arm. What must not change with that boom?
choices: How close the aim camera pulls in
quiz.why: The boom is the camera. Speed is the stick.

quiz.prompt: The player taps aim while standing in front of a door. What should open?
choices: Nothing. Aim does not call Interact
quiz.why: Use is a different action.

quiz.prompt: Where does the aim trace begin?
quiz.why: The crosshair lives on the camera.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does the aim press pull the shoulder camera in, instead of reusing the use key?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What does a trace from the feet hit, compared with the crosshair at the camera?

movement.plainEnglish: The stick is the move action. The graph compares it with zero and writes speed. The spring arm and the aim bool do not choose that speed.
movement.whyGame: If aiming slowed the pawn inside the camera graph, tuning the boom would retune the gait.

expansions.title: Idle
expansions.detail: A stick at zero writes no speed.

expansions.title: Aiming
expansions.detail: Looking down the sights is a camera bool, not a speed.

expansions.title: The boom
expansions.detail: A longer spring arm does not make the pawn faster.

quiz.prompt: What chooses third-person speed?
choices: How far the spring arm is pulled
quiz.why: The move action owns speed.

quiz.prompt: The move excerpt writes Speed inside if (IA_Move > 0.f). When does that line run?
choices: When the shoulder button is down
quiz.why: The comparison is the gate.

quiz.prompt: The stick leaves zero. Which write comes next?
choices: The sights bool from the camera graph
A squadmate step along the route
quiz.why: The stick is the move action.

quiz.prompt: Tick forces Speed = 600 even when the stick is centered. What can the player no longer do?
quiz.why: Zero on the stick is the stop.

quiz.prompt: Looking down the sights slows the pawn inside the camera graph. What else breaks when a designer shortens the boom?
choices: The gait, because speed was hiding in the camera
The stack size on a pickup
quiz.why: Camera tuning must not be movement tuning.

quiz.prompt: How fast the pawn walks comes from the stick, not from the aiming bool.
quiz.why: Speed is the stick.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the move gate?
choices: The comparison of the stick with zero
Aiming assigned from the shoulder button
The magazine compared with its cap
quiz.why: That if is where speed is written.

quiz.prompt: A longer spring arm makes the pawn look faster on screen. What number should stay the same?
quiz.why: The boom is not the gait.

quiz.prompt: The stick is centered and the pawn keeps jogging. Where was speed written?
choices: On Tick, past the stick check
Inside the stick check, which would have written zero
quiz.why: The repair puts the assignment inside the comparison.

quiz.prompt: Why is third-person speed the same contract as any other pawn?
choices: The spring arm is the input device
The squadmate owns the player's speed
quiz.why: The view changes. The contract does not.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does the stick compare against zero and write speed, while the spring arm does not?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What gait changes if aiming slows the pawn inside the camera graph?

interaction.plainEnglish: Use starts at the interact action. The trace comes from the camera, along the crosshair. A hit calls Interact on that actor. A door, a weapon on the ground, and a switch share that call.
interaction.whyGame: A trace from the chest hits the cover the camera can see past, and the prompt lights on the wrong actor.

expansions.title: A door
expansions.detail: The door implements Interact. The trace does not name the door class.

expansions.title: A weapon on the ground
expansions.detail: The prompt can find it. Putting it in the inventory is still the overlap.

expansions.title: Cover
expansions.detail: If the camera can see past it, the trace must start at the camera.

quiz.prompt: The crosshair is on a door the camera can see past a low wall. Where does the use trace start?
quiz.why: The chest trace hits the wall.

quiz.prompt: The use excerpt calls Calling Interact on the hit actor after a hit. What does that line do?
choices: It runs the hit actor's own use function
quiz.why: Interact is the interface.

quiz.prompt: The trace hits a floor switch. What call runs on that switch?
quiz.why: The true pin calls the interface.

quiz.prompt: The trace starts at the chest and the prompt lights on the wall. What is the player actually aiming at?
choices: Something past the wall, which the camera can see
quiz.why: Match the crosshair.

quiz.prompt: A door, a dropped weapon, and a switch all need use. What do they share?
choices: A cast chain, one class each
quiz.why: One call. The actor implements it.

quiz.prompt: Doors open from the use trace, not from the sights trace.
quiz.why: Aim only records the sights.

quiz.prompt: Art adds a ladder. What must the ladder implement?
choices: A new branch in the aim graph
quiz.why: The trace never lists classes.

quiz.prompt: The press that calls Interact finds a weapon and adds it to the inventory. Which event was supposed to add it?
quiz.why: Use can highlight. Overlap adds.

quiz.prompt: Which action starts third-person use?
quiz.why: Use has its own action.

quiz.prompt: The hit bool is false. What runs?
choices: The miss path, which does not call Interact
Interact on the nearest actor anyway
quiz.why: The branch is the hit.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does third-person use trace from the camera along the crosshair before it calls Interact?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What actor lights up if the trace starts at the chest and hits cover the camera can see past?

weapon.plainEnglish: Reload is its own button. The magazine is what is in the gun, reserve is what is on the body, and the mag size is the cap. Reload runs only when the mag is not full and the body still has rounds.
weapon.whyGame: Reloading from Tick or from the aim button fills the gun while the player is only looking, or while they are doing nothing.

expansions.title: The gap
expansions.detail: Needed is the reserve clamped into the space left in the magazine.

expansions.title: An empty body
expansions.detail: Reserve at zero means the branch does not run.

expansions.title: A full mag
expansions.detail: A full magazine does not take more rounds from the body.

quiz.prompt: Which action starts a third-person reload?
quiz.why: Reload is its own action.

quiz.prompt: The excerpt clamps reserve into the gap and calls that result Needed. What is Needed?
choices: How many rounds will move from the body into the gun
How long the camera boom is
quiz.why: Needed is the transfer.

quiz.prompt: The magazine is below its cap and the body has rounds. Which write comes next?
choices: The clamp of reserve into the gap
A squadmate step along the route
quiz.why: Both sides of the branch are true, so the clamp runs.

quiz.prompt: Tick adds Needed every frame. What happens while the player is only aiming?
choices: No change at all, if the frame loop knew you were only aiming
quiz.why: Reload is a button, not a frame.

quiz.prompt: The magazine is full and the body still has rounds. What should reload do?
choices: Nothing. The cap blocks the transfer
Move rounds anyway and grow the magazine past its size
quiz.why: Magazine < MagSize is required.

quiz.prompt: The aim button should reload the third-person weapon.
quiz.why: Aim is the sights. Reload is its own button.

quiz.prompt: Reserve is zero and the magazine is half empty. Which part of the branch fails?
quiz.why: There is nothing on the body to move.

quiz.prompt: Which three numbers describe the gun?
choices: The sights, the gait, and hit points
Stack count, route direction, and the boom length
The camera location, the chest location, and the crosshair
quiz.why: In the gun, on the body, and the cap.

quiz.prompt: You clamp Needed and forget to subtract it from reserve. What does the next reload see?
choices: The same rounds still on the body
quiz.why: The transfer has to leave the body.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the reload gate?
quiz.why: Both have to be true.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why is reload its own button, and only when the magazine is not full and reserve remains?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What fills the gun while the player is only aiming if reload is wired to Tick or to the aim button?

health.plainEnglish: A hit is Any Damage on the server. The health write sits inside the authority check. The number 90 in the sample is a stand-in. Other players see the body from the replicated result, and they do not apply the hit again.
health.whyGame: A client reaction that also writes health makes two machines disagree about which body fell.

expansions.title: The sample
expansions.detail: Replace 90 with the computed result.

expansions.title: The reaction
expansions.detail: Play the hit reaction from the notify. Do not subtract again.

expansions.title: The body
expansions.detail: Other players can see this pawn, so the number has to match.

quiz.prompt: Where does a third-person health write sit?
choices: On the client that shows the hit flash
quiz.why: The server owns the body everyone can see.

quiz.prompt: The excerpt assigns Health = 90.f inside the authority check. What is 90?
choices: A sample you replace with the computed result
quiz.why: 90 is a stand-in.

quiz.prompt: The server has written the new health. What should the other machines play?
choices: The hit reaction, from the notify
quiz.why: The notify shows the result.

quiz.prompt: The client plays a hit reaction by subtracting health locally. What do two players disagree about?
quiz.why: Two writes, two bodies.

quiz.prompt: The sample writes Health after an empty authority check. What is the repair?
choices: Nest the assignment inside the check
Delete the check and write on every client
Move the write into the aim action
quiz.why: The check has to wrap the write.

quiz.prompt: A client hit flash should subtract health again.
quiz.why: The flash shows the server number.

quiz.prompt: Which event is the hit?
quiz.why: Damage is the event.

quiz.prompt: Why does this health float have to replicate when a first-person one might feel private?
choices: Other players can see this body
The magazine is visible, so health must share its float
The squadmate timer replicates through health
quiz.why: The body is on screen for everyone.

quiz.prompt: A medkit writes health on the owning client. What snaps when the server answers?
choices: The body, back to the server number
How long the camera boom is
quiz.why: The client number was never authority.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the health write?
choices: Aiming assigned from the shoulder button
quiz.why: Authority wraps health.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does Any Damage change third-person health only inside the authority check?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What do two machines disagree about if a client reaction also writes health?

inventory.plainEnglish: A pickup touches the capsule. Overlap adds it when the stack count is positive. Aiming at it and pressing use do not increment the count. The most the stack can hold lives on the item.
inventory.whyGame: The weapon on your back is the inventory. Filling it from the aim trace means looking at a rifle picks it up.

expansions.title: The back
expansions.detail: The visible weapon on the body is the slot, not a second inventory.

expansions.title: The cap
expansions.detail: Compare against the stack size on the item before accepting more.

expansions.title: Empty
expansions.detail: A count of zero stores zero and does not add.

quiz.prompt: A rifle on the ground touches the capsule. Which event adds it?
quiz.why: Touching the capsule is the pickup.

quiz.prompt: The overlap excerpt sees StackCount > 0 and calls ProcessEvent on AddToSlot. What does that line do?
choices: It asks the inventory to take the item
quiz.why: A positive count means add.

quiz.prompt: The count is positive. What call takes the item?
quiz.why: The true pin adds.

quiz.prompt: Looking at a rifle adds it to the back. What did the aim trace do that belongs to overlap?
choices: A step along the squadmate route
quiz.why: Aim looks. Overlap picks up.

quiz.prompt: The stack is already at the size named on the item. What should another overlap do?
choices: Grow the stack past the asset
quiz.why: The cap is on the item.

quiz.why: Use is not the overlap.

quiz.prompt: Where does the stack cap live?
choices: As a literal inside the aim graph
quiz.why: Beside the item's name.

quiz.prompt: The overlap runs and the count is zero. What does the excerpt do?
choices: It stores zero and does not add
quiz.why: Empty means no add.

A private count the overlap cannot see

assignment.whyGamePrompt: What gets picked up by looking if the weapon on your back fills from the aim trace?

companion.plainEnglish: The squadmate walks a short route beside you. Begin Play starts one timer that calls the route step. The sample timer does not loop, so the next step has to be scheduled on purpose. The return path is still empty.
companion.whyGame: Stepping from Tick walks the squadmate through a pause, and starting a new timer inside the step piles timers until the squadmate sprints.

expansions.title: Orders
expansions.detail: This route is not the player's stick.

save.plainEnglish: The third-person slot stores health, the magazine, the reserve, the stack count, aiming only if the camera must stay tight, and the squadmate's next route point. It does not store the spring-arm mesh or the mapping context. Load happens at Begin Play.
save.whyGame: Copying health into the slot every frame stores a half-applied hit, and saving the spring arm saves a mesh the level already has.

expansions.title: The camera
expansions.detail: Save Aiming only when the mode needs the tight camera after load.

expansions.title: The gun
expansions.detail: Magazine and reserve are both part of the gun.

expansions.title: When
expansions.detail: Write the struct on an event. Load it at Begin Play.

choices: On an event such as the player saving
When the stick returns to zero

Begin Play cannot read a struct
The input bindings is only valid on Tick
